completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the release evidence bundle schema and fixture exist, release automation validates required fields before GA, and generated reports record registry states and warnings. It does not claim RC or GA support when required release evidence or limitation handling is missing from concrete release artifacts.

support_scope.local_completion: The evidence bundle schema, generator, fixture, and documentation are present and validated.
support_scope.external_gate: not applicable, but RC/GA promotion still depends on concrete release artifacts carrying the required bundle evidence and limitation handling.
support_scope.runtime_support_claim: No release-candidate, GA, package, stream, or calculator support claim is made by this bundle format alone.

remaining_external_gates: RC/GA release claims must still be backed by concrete release artifacts with the required bundle evidence
limitation handling remains a release-path gate, not a schema-only claim

gap_blockers.description: Release bundles must include registry evidence so recipe-only, private, future-only, unpublished, and published-with-gaps states cannot be mistaken for public publication evidence.
Release automation must reject RC or GA claims when required bundle evidence is missing or marked with unresolved limitations.

gap_register.description: Release bundles must include registry evidence so recipe-only, private, future-only, unpublished, and published-with-gaps states cannot be mistaken for public publication evidence.
Release automation must reject RC or GA claims when required bundle evidence is missing or marked with unresolved limitations.

promotion_requirements: Require registry evidence in every release evidence bundle.
Attach evidence bundles to release artifacts before RC or GA support claims.
Reject GA promotion when required evidence is missing or gap statuses remain unresolved.
description: Define the release evidence bundle required before release-candidate or GA support claims.
